items.source: Requests are handled by forwarding through the RequestDispatcher obtained via the name specified through the "defaultServletName" property. In most cases, the defaultServletName does not need to be set explicitly, as the handler checks at initialization time for the presence of the default Servlet of well-known containers such as Tomcat, Jetty, WebLogic and WebSphere. However, when running in a container where the default Servlet's name is not known, or where it has been customized via server configuration, the defaultServletName will need to be set explicitly.
items.translation: 请求通过由"defaultServletName" 属性指定的名称获取的RequestDispatcher进行转发来处理。在大多数情况下，无需显式设置defaultServletName，因为处理器会在初始化时检查 Tomcat、Jetty、WebLogic 和 WebSphere 等知名容器的默认 Servlet 是否存在。但是，如果在默认 Servlet 名称未知的容器中运行，或者其名称已通过服务器配置进行了自定义，则必须显式设置defaultServletName。

items.source: This handler is intended to be used with a "/*" mapping when the DispatcherServlet is mapped to "/", thus overriding the Servlet container's default handling of static resources. The mapping to this handler should generally be ordered as the last in the chain so that it will only execute when no other more specific mappings (i.e., to controllers) can be matched.
items.translation: 此处理器旨在与"/*"映射配合使用，当 DispatcherServlet 被映射到 "/" 时，从而覆盖 Servlet 容器对静态资源的默认处理。该处理器的映射通常应作为链中的最后一项进行排序，以确保仅在无法匹配其他更具体的映射（即控制器）时才执行。

items.source: If the defaultServletName property has not been explicitly set, attempts to locate the default Servlet using the known common container-specific names.
items.translation: 如果未显式设置 `defaultServletName` 属性，则尝试使用已知的特定于容器的常见名称来定位默认 Servlet。
